scope: Read-only audit of frozen M0/M1 code and A2 v2 train/valid arrays; no A3 sample access, model edit, or seed rerun
primary_reason: The strict requested final path requires supplied A3 text_bert with the same frozen BERT. M0/M1 are unaligned_500 models. The frozen unaligned A3 schema has raw_text, not a supplied text_bert field. The current bridge has no A3 inference adapter. Mixing aligned A3 text_bert with unaligned A3 audio/vision would also mix version-specific text interventions and has not been justified.

text_interface.path: pilot_ru.load_split(text_bert) -> pilot_cache/clean_{train,valid}.npy generated by pilot_stage4.cache_clean_bert with frozen local BertModel; gap text IDs changed to [UNK] then encoded into ru_gap_text_seed*.npy -> pilot_ru.build_input -> q2_bridge.NativeMulT.forward
text_interface.A3_frozen_schema: unaligned: raw_text -> pinned tokenizer -> same BERT; aligned: supplied text_bert -> same BERT. These are version-specific paths.
text_interface.deployability_note: An in-memory text_bert triplet can be generated from unaligned A3 raw_text under the frozen Stage 2.5 contract, but that is not a supplied A3 text_bert field and no final inference routine exists in the bridge.

text_padding.pooling: NativeMulT.pool uses P!=0 (and O!=0 for M1); no unmasked mean over 50 text positions; padded query results are excluded.
text_padding.cross_attention: All 50 text positions are computed as independent queries to audio and vision, including padded positions. Text is never a key/value in bridge cross-attention, and padded query outputs do not enter pooled prediction. Query-side computation is not explicitly skipped.

unaligned_bridge.M0_behavior: P=1: audio timestep 0 is retained as a cross-attention key/value; O is not used.
unaligned_bridge.M1_behavior: P=1/O=1: audio timestep 0 is retained as a cross-attention key/value.

aligned_reference_not_used_by_bridge.state_at_t0: P=2/O=2 for every sample; unresolved, not synthetic or verified missing

label_mapping.regression: Original continuous regression_label y is passed as float32 for loss and evaluated at its stored value; it is not binarized or replaced by class index.
label_mapping.source_integrity: Frozen cleaning and label audits report labels copied unchanged from A2; no A2 test records were opened here.

zero_not_missing.M0: Uses P only for key/pool availability and ignores O; no feature-magnitude missing detector.
zero_not_missing.M1: Consumes frozen P/O. Native zero rows that lack trustworthy absence evidence are O=2 and remain available; only frozen known O=0 and explicit synthetic injected O=0 are excluded.
zero_not_missing.synthetic_injection: RU native masks target P=1/O=1 eligible positions, alter a separate copied input and mark those positions O=0. Native content and frozen v2 files remain unchanged.

A3_future_interface.official_file_order_preservation: Model forward can consume arrays indexed by caller order without a sample-level ID; a future A3 runner must carry external file/order keys. This has not yet been implemented or tested.
